text: Disappointed. I ordered thus it came with a white background and the glow in the dark feature has never worked. It does keep time well though and on a single as battery

product_metadata.title: Plumeet Night Light Wall Clock 13'' Bedroom Wall Clocks with Silent Non-Ticking Glowing Function - Battery Operated Decorative Wall Clock for Home, Kitchen, Living Room (Green Light)
features: Glowing up Function -- Glowing clock hands and large 3D numbers makes it easier to read at night, especially suitable for the elderly and people with poor eyesight. make it easy to read the time from any corner of your room both day and night.
Long Luminous Time -- The numbers and clock hands are all coated with phosphor, Light up about 4 hours if this clock receives enough sunlight at day, then get dimmer as the night wears on.

Super Quiet Movement -- Every movement has been strictly tested, Precise quartz clock movement with smooth sweeping second hand, not only keep the time accurate, but also make the movement quiet, no ticking, suitable put it in your bedroom or study without any concern.
Wall Clock Battery Operated: Powered by 1 AA battery(Not included). a brand new battery can be used for more than one year. Hooks included with the clock , wide slot in back for easy hanging.
